question: What is the meaning of sustainability certifications in relation to life-cycle data?
description: Sustainability certifications, such as BREEAM and LEED, are tools used to assess the sustainability of buildings by evaluating their environmental impact and conformity with green building standards. These certifications rely on life-cycle data to understand the sustainability and circularity characteristics of a product, estimate the circular value, and identify circular opportunities. Life-cycle data can reside at the small object level and be linked for use in larger objects, providing insight into the sustainability and circularity of a product, identifying and estimating the value of components for circular use, and listing alternative circular options. Therefore, sustainability certifications use life-cycle data to evaluate the environmental impact of a building throughout its life cycle, from material sourcing to end-of-life disposal or recycling.
